ELI5: Voat scalability, or how will Voat scale capacity for all the new traffic it is getting?

The right answer is to go with cloud hosting. Initially, it looks like they put up a couple new servers and got a bigger pipe. In reality, they need to move to cloud hosting with Amazon S3 or Rackspace, or some other node'd hosting company where scalability is just part of the structure. The only issue becomes content and whether or not they will allow it.

With this type of setup, servers can be replicated across many sites allowing shortest path and DDOS mitigation, as well as auto rollover in the case of a down server, or network outage, etc...
